notes: First clean Lovable run: one prompt, no fixes, every criterion met. Home with the studio name and a tagline, a gallery of twelve photographs, three series pages (Harbour Light, Interiors, Quiet Portraits) with six images each, an about page with a real bio, and a contact form that answers with a thank-you. Clicking an image opens it at 2400x1600 in a lightbox. No horizontal scroll at 320, 390 or 430 px. Published free at still-point-photo-stories.lovable.app.
